title: Providers registry (data/registries/providers.json)
description: The bodies and people the map catalogue credits, with the full and short names the catalogue's provider filter and rows show. One entry per body; other spellings of the same body are its aliases.

id.description: The provider's id, as the filter's state keeps it.

name.description: The provider as the catalogue credits it (a map's provider string).

full.description: Its full name: the filter's list.

short.description: Its short name: a row's credit line and the filter's summary.

body.description: Its id in data/database/providers.json, the attribution registry.

aliases.description: Other provider strings for the same body.
